action_items: INFO — All V1 acceptance criteria PASS. No blocking issues. Main agent can ship.
OPTIONAL/NICE-TO-HAVE — /api/leads POST stores raw user_agent (300 char) and x-forwarded-for IP. Confirm this is intended for CCPA/GDPR; if not desired, gate behind a config flag.
OPTIONAL — Consent checkbox uses native browser checkbox styling on mobile (white square). Could be styled with the gold/ember palette for visual consistency with the rest of the form. Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: leads.py is clean: 105 lines, async/await correct, _id excluded from list response via projection {'_id':0} + sanitize, Pydantic validation on role + EmailStr, 24h dedupe is idempotent and uses indexed (email, role, created_at) read.

ContactWaitlist.jsx correctly reads error.response.data.detail for FastAPI HTTPException shape (the 'Consent is required.' string surfaces correctly via this path). Good defensive default fallback message.
Field component is local helper (not exported). Fine for single-file use; if other forms reuse this pattern, extract to shared/.
ContactWaitlist.jsx uses axios while rest of app may use fetch — minor inconsistency, non-blocking.

leads.py role validator could accept 'Game Master' string from the dropdown if user typed 'gm' upper but does NOT accept the human-readable label 'Game Master' (would 422). Frontend sends value='gm' so this is fine — but if a partner integration sends 'Game Master', it will 422. Consider documenting allowed values in OpenAPI description.
